name: bug friend sim!!
source:
oh no! you've been shrunk down! at least there's some cute bugs here that you can talk too...

make friends with these two weird bugs, while also trying to get back to your normal life!

[From [url=https://saeiken.itch.io/bug-friend-sim]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
糟了！你被縮小了！好在這裡有幾隻可愛的小蟲子，可以陪你聊聊天……

和這兩隻古里古怪的小蟲交個朋友，同時也別忘了想辦法回到原本的生活！

［摘自[url=https://saeiken.itch.io/bug-friend-sim]itch.io[/url]］
